notes: Soft gap: reported accuracies include the private 20% split (public-only numbers appear only in Supplemental Figure 6); the gpt-4-turbo snapshot is not stated (paper dated July 2024, resolved by the alias rule). TableQA/FigQA need image inputs.

resolution.plan: Gap is a private split: Supplementary Table 2 averages the public 80% and a withheld 20% of every subtask, and only the public part is on HF. Run the public LitQA2 split (about 199 of 248 items) three times with the Appendix D.1 zero-shot CoT template, random option permutation and the extra 'Insufficient information' option, parse the [ANSWER] tag by regex, and compare mean accuracy with 0.12 at the set level. Appendix B.1 / Figure 6 report that public and private mean accuracies differ by under 5 points, so the comparison is approximate but bounded.
resolution.approximation: 20% of items unavailable; Claude 2 fallback parser replaced by regex-only (or a live parser); gpt-4-turbo snapshot assumed 2024-04-09.
